requirements: Is there exactly one single full-body painting of Tom and nothing else?
Is Tom standing alone and facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle toward the left?
Is Tom's head tipped slightly forward with eyes looking toward the left?
Are both of Tom's hands loosely clasped in front at the waist?
Is Tom's mouth closed in a small attentive smile?
Does Tom fill about 85 percent of the picture height and appear centered with an even empty margin all around?
Does the figure match the exact face, hair, build, age, clothes and colors from the approved hero painting and talking sheet?
Is the pose and painted finish consistent in size with the attached talking sheet?
